text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The High Court in northern Mzuzu on Tuesday impounded a motor vehicle belonging to former Alliance For Democracy party executive member, Machipisa Munthali, for allegedly failing to settle a K2,862 ($191) debt from May 1996.

- Prosecutor Geoffrey Robertson, fighting against the 1995 acquittal of former president Kamuzu Banda for murder, said the trial judge had been unfair to reject evidence which amounted to unbalanced exercise of judicial requirements.
